name: Support ticket summarizer
description: Checks that ticket summaries cite the ticket ID, assign a priority (P1–P3), stay short, and never promise refunds.

prompts.name: v2 — structured
prompts.system: You are a support triage assistant. Be concise and factual.

vars.ticket: Nobody on our team can log in since 9am. SSO returns error 500 for every user.

mockResponses.baseline: Customers cannot log in because SSO is returning a 500 error.
mockResponses.structured: [T-1001] P1 — All users are locked out; SSO has returned HTTP 500 since 09:00.

vars.ticket: I was charged twice for my March invoice and I want my money back.

mockResponses.baseline: The customer was double-charged in March and we will refund the duplicate payment.
mockResponses.structured: [T-1002] P2 — Customer reports a duplicate charge on the March invoice; billing to investigate.

vars.ticket: Would be great if we could export the usage report as CSV.

mockResponses.baseline: [T-1003] P3 — Customer asks for CSV export of the usage report.
mockResponses.structured: [T-1003] P2 — Customer asks for CSV export of the usage report.
[T-1004] P3 — The report is too vague to act on; we need more information from the customer.
